conflicts: The anchor's greying, medium-length hair forms curled wings over the ears and extends at the nape; Sergeant Sayed is an Egyptian commando and must have short black military-groomed hair.

issues: Photorealistic, ordinary and anatomically sound, with natural weathered skin and a period-plausible mustache.
Hair is visibly grey and too long at the sides and nape for the commando grooming rule.
exhausted@154838 has a narrower, older face, drooping eyes, tighter black hair and reduced temple greying compared with the anchor.
looking-up@154838 has a slimmer facial structure, altered nose and jaw, and short nearly all-black hair.
three-quarter-right-golden@154838 has unnaturally amber-looking eyes and noticeably darker, shorter hair than the anchor.
soaking-wet@154838 includes a modern-looking streetlight in the background.
Otherwise the set has strong variety in angles, framing, expressions, lighting, outfits and action, and the captions correctly describe only changing scene attributes.

redesign_change: Keep the face, skin, build, receding hairline and thick bushy mustache unchanged, but replace the greying curled hair with short cropped black hair lying clear of the ears and nape.
summary: The weathered Egyptian sergeant look is strong and photorealistic, but the signature greying, over-ear hair directly violates the required short-black-hair commando grooming rule; several training images also drift and one contains a modern-looking streetlight.
name: Hazem Abdallah
